CLIPPY ILLUSTRATION PLACEHOLDER

This imageset requires a clippy-illustration.png file.

Download a Clippy or paperclip illustration from:
- https://img.icons8.com/?id=CYKLk4DosdHW&format=png&size=512
- https://svgmix.com/item/Xo3N0X/microsoft-clippy (convert SVG to PNG)
- https://seeklogo.com/vector-logo/92270/microsoft-clippy

Specifications:
- Filename: clippy-illustration.png
- Size: 512x512 pixels or larger
- Format: PNG-24 with transparency
- Place this file in the same directory as this README

Once added, remove this README file.
